label: OpenAI Codex
description: Branch `codex`, for Codex CLI / app plugins. Codex plugins carry skills only: commands become user-invoked skills (agents/openai.yaml policy; mentions rewritten to `$agentex:<skill>`), agent definitions move to references/agents/ and are dispatched as native subagents, the plugin root becomes a placeholder (Codex expands it for hooks only), and the manifest moves to .codex-plugin/plugin.json. Codex has no structured ask tool outside Plan mode, and its sandbox blocks network by default; the preamble covers both.

transforms.replacement: message (numbered questions with lettered options; then stop and wait for the reply)

transforms.text: > **AgenTeX on {host}.** `<agentex-root>` stands for this plugin's install folder: `{root}` from the folder this file is in. Resolve it to an absolute path before you run or read anything that uses it. When a step says to dispatch a bundled agent (`qa-executor`, `api-executor`, `mobile-qa-executor`), spawn a native subagent and give it the body of `<agentex-root>/references/agents/<name>.md` as its instructions, plus the values this file says to inject. Steps that reach the network (`curl`, `az`, `sqlcmd`, `playwright-cli` on a remote site, the tracker scripts) need network access: if the sandbox blocks one, ask the user to approve it; never skip the step or report it as passed.

forbiddenText.why: Codex expands it for hooks only
